content.short: Money platform for holding and exchanging NGN, CAD, USD, USDT and USDC, and paying globally.
content.description: Juicyway lets businesses and individuals keep local and foreign currency accounts and switch between naira, Canadian and US dollars, USDT and USDC in real time. Businesses can pay vendors and contractors abroad, run bulk payouts and payroll, collect through payment links, and add collections and payouts to their own products via API. Crypto trading with charts sits alongside.
content.meta: Hold and swap naira, CAD, USD, USDT and USDC, run payroll and pay globally with Juicyway's web, mobile and API tools.
